data.name: ScopeReadSkills
data.comment: An ESI permission (scope), under the Skills heading: read the character's skills.

data.name: ScopeReadSkillQueue
data.comment: An ESI permission (scope), under the Skills heading: read the character's skill queue.

data.name: ScopeOpenWindow
data.comment: An ESI permission (scope), under the UI heading: open windows in the game client.

data.name: ScopeWriteWaypoint
data.comment: An ESI permission (scope), under the UI heading: set autopilot waypoints in the game client.

data.name: ScopeReadStructures
data.comment: An ESI permission (scope), under the Universe heading (details of player-owned structures) or the Corp heading (the corporation's structures).

data.name: ScopeReadCharacterWallet
data.comment: An ESI permission (scope), under the Wallet heading: read the character's wallet.

data.name: ScopeReadContracts
data.comment: An ESI permission (scope), in the list shown when a corporation is added, under the Contracts heading: read the corporation's contracts.

data.name: ScopeReadContainerLogs
data.comment: An ESI permission (scope), in a corporation's list, under the Corp heading: read the logs of the corporation's containers.

data.name: ScopeReadMembership
data.comment: An ESI permission (scope), in a corporation's list, under the Corp heading: read who the corporation's members are.

data.name: ScopeReadDivisions
data.comment: An ESI permission (scope), in a corporation's list, under the Corp heading: read the names of the corporation's hangar and wallet divisions.

data.name: ScopeReadFacilities
data.comment: An ESI permission (scope), in a corporation's list, under the Corp heading: read the corporation's industry facilities.

data.name: ScopeReadProjects
data.comment: An ESI permission (scope), in a corporation's list, under the Corp heading: read the corporation's projects.

data.name: ScopeReadStarbases
data.comment: An ESI permission (scope), in a corporation's list, under the Corp heading: read the corporation's starbases (control towers).

data.name: ScopeTrackMembers
data.comment: An ESI permission (scope), in a corporation's list, under the Corp heading: see where the corporation's members are and when they last logged in.

data.name: ScopeReadJobs
data.comment: An ESI permission (scope), in a corporation's list, under the Industry heading: read the corporation's industry jobs.

data.name: ScopeReadMining
data.comment: An ESI permission (scope), in a corporation's list, under the Industry heading: read the corporation's moon mining.

data.name: ScopeReadOrders
data.comment: An ESI permission (scope), in a corporation's list, under the Markets heading: read the corporation's market orders.

data.name: ScopeReadCorpStructures
data.comment: An ESI permission (scope), in a corporation's list, under the Structures heading: read the corporation's structures. "Read" is a verb.

data.name: ScopeReadWallet
data.comment: An ESI permission (scope), in a corporation's list, under the Wallet heading: read the corporation's wallet. ESI has this one and Read Wallets (plural) side by side.

data.name: ScopeReadWallets
data.comment: An ESI permission (scope), in a corporation's list, under the Wallet heading: read the corporation's wallets (its wallet divisions). ESI has this one and Read Wallet (singular) side by side.

data.name: ScopeGroupAccess
data.comment: Heading over a group of ESI permissions (scopes), in the list shown when a character is added and in Settings → ESI Tokens: access lists.
